notes.title: Game Update #3
notes.notes:
Fixed:
Aura passive of the defense tower "Bastion" was not taking effect.

notes.title: Game Update #2
notes.notes:
Fixes
A passive ability that triggers when a monster is killed by friendly damage was incorrectly targeting towers, leading to towers being destroyed.

The type restriction for the purification effect of aqua-element skill was not taking effect.

When creating a new game, game names containing abnormal characters could cause save files to fail to read correctly.

A crash issue that could occur when a large number of bouncing projectiles attack a large number of monsters.
Changes
The tower "Tsunami" had an incorrect range that far exceeded the normal value, which has now been adjusted back.

Reduced the frequency of effects triggered by the interaction between spark and aqua elements, while increasing the damage they deal. Overall damage has been improved.
Features
Add Save Management.

Rename: Modify the display name of save files in the game.

Copy Path: Copy the save file path to the system clipboard.

Create Copy: Generate a duplicate of the save file.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
Fixes

Fixed an issue where a time zone problem caused a black screen on startup.

Improvements

Adjusted the attack speed value provided by the aura of the high - level Wind Tower.
